description: A tiling window manager for Windows, with an animation engine, a status bar, and a configuration language that tells you when you have made a mistake.
notes: Shubbak is installed but not running yet.
shubbak autostart enable    start the window manager at logon
shubbak-wm --foreground     run it now, attached to this terminal
Run 'shubbak config-path' to see which one is in effect, and start from the
This build is not code signed, so it cannot move windows belonging to
elevated processes unless you run shubbak-wm elevated too.
